title: President Trump Refers to Military Reports on Strange Objects in the Sky

content:
6 min read

Just now

--

In a new “60 Minutes” interview with Ross Douthat on CBS (accessible here), President Trump Trumps recalls: “I sat in the Oval Office, first term, and a little bit second term, meeting with Air Force pilots that are really good, solid people… And they’ve told me things that are very strange, in certain cases. They said, ‘Yes, there’s something going on out there.’ Because they’re flying an F-22, which is the best there is, the fastest […] And something goes by them at three times their speed, and it’s round. It’s not aerodynamic.” When Douthat asked: “But then, along with those pilots, there’s a set of people who have styled themselves as whistleblowers, who have come out and said, ‘Actually, there’s also a secret program that even presidents don’t know about to study this stuff.’ Have you seen any evidence that that is the case?” Trump replied: “No! And I haven’t heard that. But if there is, I’m gonna find out about it right after this interview.” To the concluding question: “But you’re interested in it because people are interested in it, not because you’re on the way to discovering it?”, President Trump replied: “I would like to find out whether or not it’s true. I will tell you, you have a lot of very solid people that believe it’s true.”

Below is the transcript of an interview I had a day later with Jesse Weber. The video of this interview is available here. Jesse’s questions are marked with JW and my answers with AL.

***

JW: New revelations tonight about possible otherworldly sightings in our skies. And the news is coming straight from President Donald Trump. In an interview with CBS’s 60 Minutes, the President said that he has been briefed on several unusual sightings reported by Air Force pilots throughout both of his terms. And he believes that fighter jet pilots are pretty reliable sources when it comes to those encounters: “They’re the real deal. And they’ve told me things that are very strange. They said that, in certain cases, they said, yes, there’s something going on out there, because they’re flying an F-22, which is the best there is, the fastest, the best plane that anyone’s ever seen. And something goes by them at three times their speed, and it’s round. It’s not aerodynamic, it’s round.”

So, what could these sightings be? Is it more proof that we’re not alone? Joining me now, chair of the UAP Science Advisory Council, Avi Loeb. He’s also the Frank Baird Jr. Professor of Science at Harvard.

Good to see you, sir. Okay, have you spoken to these pilots? Do you have any idea what these apparent sightings could be?

AL: Thanks for having me. Yes, I did speak to some pilots. And indeed, these reports are reliable and puzzling. We are expecting to speak with some people who saw the evidence tomorrow at the UAP Science Advisory Council.

What can I say? These are puzzling observations.

JW: And you believe them. They seem reliable. They seem credible.

AL: Definitely. These are people who are well trained and they do not hallucinate. They use their best instruments at their disposal.

But, of course, one can do better in principle. If we can put better sensors in those locations where they spotted these objects, we can actually figure out what these objects are and what they’re made of. And that is my goal, to partner with the Pentagon on this mission.

In fact, we are about to put together a new concept of an observatory in Ithaca, New York, at the old residence of Carl Sagan. The project is just starting now, and within a year we hope to construct a passive radar system that will scan the sky and then steer a large telescope towards an object of interest. That was never done before with a meter-sized telescope that can get high-resolution image of such an object and also take a spectrum of it so that we can infer the object’s composition. This new Galileo observatory will be a test of this new observatory concept, and we hope to partner with the Pentagon and place it in locations that are potentially interesting.

JW: What theoretically could go three times faster than these fighter jets?

AL: The puzzle is not just the propulsion, as the pilots say there are no visible signs of propulsion. The puzzle is that round objects that move faster than the speed of sound should create a shock wave, a hot blast wave in the air, and that was not observed. Moreover, there is more friction and drag on objects the faster they move through air. So there is something unusual with the way these strange objects move through air that we don’t fully understand, in addition to the propulsion.

And you know, it’s work in progress. It’s like a detective story. It makes life interesting. A better understanding is definitely something to look forward to.

JW: Okay, I’ve got to ask… You got to talk with me about this. So, the President also told 60 Minutes that he hasn’t seen any evidence of what whistleblowers claim is a secret government program to study UFOs. It’s so secret that it would be hidden from Presidents. Can you tell us anything about that or no?

AL: We heard David Grusch testify under oath in front of the U.S. Congress as well as most recently Jay Stratton talking about material objects, spacecraft that are intact and are withheld within corporations or by the U.S. government. I have not seen any direct evidence for that.

JW: Would you tell me, Avi? Would you tell me?

AL: I would admit it if I knew because that would be a shortcut to the truth. Instead of studying fast moving objects in the sky, it would be simpler to examine something that is stationary in the laboratory, where we can find out what it’s made of and how it works. That would be amazing.

I haven’t seen it, but I would love to see it if it’s out there. My message to all these people who claim that such objects exist is simple: “Take me to the nearest alien spacecraft.”

JW: What a message that would be. That’s what you need. That is the T-shirt I want to see Avi Loeb wearing next time I have you on. Before I let you go, should we expect a btach of UFO files release coming anytime soon?

AL: We are not done. Obviously, there is a lot of classified information in the pipeline. And much of it is classified because it was taken by classified sensors and not because of the targets. So, if we will get better data with unclassified instruments, it could be shared with the public.

JW: Good, good, because I think we all still have an appetite for more information to see what’s happening. Avi, thank you so much for taking the time, as always. I really appreciate it. I love when you call it a detective story because that’s exactly what it is. It is an investigation. We’re all trying to get to the bottom of it and get some clues.

So, Avi Loeb, we always appreciate you. Thank you.

AL: Thanks for having me.

ABOUT THE AUTHOR

Avi Loeb is chair of the UAP Science Advisory Council to the White House, Pentagon, FBI and intelligence agencies, director of the Galileo Project, founding director of Harvard University’s — Black Hole Initiative (2016–2021), former director of the Institute for Theory and Computation at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics (2005–2026), and the former chair of the astronomy department at Harvard University (2011–2020). He is a former member of the President’s Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (2018–2019) and a former chair of the Board on Physics and Astronomy of the National Academies (2018–2021). He is the bestselling author of “Extraterrestrial: The First Sign of Intelligent Life Beyond Earth” and a co-author of the textbook “Life in the Cosmos”, both published in 2021. The paperback edition of his new book, titled “Interstellar”, was published in August 2024.
